scope: One pronunciation instruction appended to existing answer_prompt through the native revision-checked settings API. No live client figures or private job identifiers included.
checks: The appended instruction requests exactly the owner-specified Russian letter names эс ка ю in voice text. It changes no arithmetic, source mapping, question or transport.

The complete previous answer_prompt is preserved verbatim as a prefix. request_planning_prompt and answer_extra_instruction are copied unchanged and checked after save. No product source or Station rewrite is introduced.
Installer pins the change file hash, current settings hash and revision; it acquires the shared recovery lock and refuses active QUEUED/RUNNING jobs and unexpired READY clarification objects.
Uses the configured existing authorized IPC peer. Payload is JSON terminated with an actual newline via chr(10); no permission changes or alternative access path are used.

Compared with the previously approved settings updater. Native Settings.save performs revision CAS and atomic private-file persistence; local gateway enforces the configured Unix peer and exact settings schema.

An owned pre-save backup is retained with final mode0600. No duplicate append or repeated installer attempt is accepted. Native readback and on-disk settings must exactly match the desired incremented revision and three strings.

Transport/process/JSON ambiguity after save triggers only a settings read, never a second save. Explicit API errors abort. Release pointer, manifest and runtime configuration must match their pre-save state.
No restart, live marketplace call, model call or final-answer postprocessing is part of this installer.

relocated_synthetic_boundaries.method: Exact installer logic with temporary fixture paths/pins, real native Settings persistence and mocked subprocess IPC; no remote commands or sockets. Each branch asserts at most one save. Success cases verify exact retained prefix, unchanged other fields, backup contents/mode and installation receipt.

primary_executor_evidence.source: SERVER_TEST_PROOF.json and primary executor message; server checks were not independently rerun remotely by reviewer
primary_executor_evidence.reported_transport_check: Primary executor extracted the active response function and verified synthetically that text is copied into tts, including the requested Russian letter words.

limitations: This approves the exact setting change and installer, not a completed installation or voice acceptance.
Prompt compliance remains probabilistic. The next exact voice retest and its final text/tts transcript must confirm the requested spelling.
Historic outbound TTS/audio was not retained. No acoustic recording, acoustic replay or guaranteed spoken pronunciation is claimed.
